live.note: Live join on this worktree: CC-0024.json is absent so the nine catalog-stated floors are the requirement set. mapping_rule.evidence: A mapping must be STRUCTURAL - a REQ id in the test id, a marker, or a registry entry. A mapping asserted only by a code comment does not count and is reported as unmapped.
